title: Trial scenario
description: A simulated real-world problem a brand gets, for cstack trial: agent teams given only the brand's files answer it, and the trial measures whether their work still reads as one brand. Library entries live in cstack trials/scenarios/ and name no real brand.

situation.description: what happened, in the words a brand manager would hear it

asker.description: who asks: a buyer, a creator, the founder, legal

deadline.description: the time pressure, as the asker states it

constraint.description: the catch that makes it hard and tests the system

kind.description: picture = a generated image; vector = flat artwork with real type; mockup = artwork placed on an object; page = a web or email section; copy = words only

size.description: size or aspect the asker needs

pictures.description: generated images this application may use; defaults by kind (picture 4, mockup 2, others 0)

success.description: what the asker checks before saying yes

flows.description: library flows the makers should follow
